attributes.board_name: Arizona State Veterinary Medical Examining Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE: taught by or under a veterinary college; sponsored by AzVMA, AAVSB, Board-approved state or national veterinary associations or academies; RACE-approved; or pre-approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license in an even-numbered year: 10 credit hours before first renewal. Graduates within 11 months before applying may use 10 h of veterinary college coursework at first renewal.
rules.alternatives: Written waiver request to the Board by December 10 before the license expires.

topics.who: Licensees authorized to prescribe Schedule II controlled substances with a DEA registration (opioid, substance use disorder or addiction CE; counts toward the 20 h)

rules.notes: Max 2 h practice management; max 5 h combined for presenting, tapes/CDs and journal reading. Internet interactive programs count hour for hour. Renewal form lists each course; online CE needs the provider certificate. Rule text read is Supp. 13-3.
